npc_god_chaos_6:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original dark-fantasy RPG enemy PIXEL ART animation sheet, matching our approved weathered skeletons and desert NPCs: dark brown-black crisp contours, angular low-resolution pixel clusters, material shading and a restrained varied palette. Grounded 16-bit game sprite style, not chibi, smooth painting, vector, 3D or glossy icon. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY 6 columns x 4 rows of separate characters = 24 full-body poses, equal cells on a square canvas. The figures must be SMALL inside the cells: occupy only central 55% of each cell width, with at least 22% clear transparent padding BOTH SIDES and broad gutters between ALL individual silhouettes. Fully show every foot, wing, horn, tail, weapon and corpse, never touching another frame or a canvas edge. Same character, same full-body scale and LEFT-facing three-quarter side camera in every cell. Rows top to bottom IDLE/MOVE/ATTACK/DIE, six actual articulated poses per row. Idle/move loops, attack windup/contact/recover, death complete final settled remains near the same floor baseline. No captions, text, labels, borders, grids, floor, background objects, or cast shadows. No half bodies. Never replace the death sequence with isolated heads or a fully transparent last frame. The whole creature remains fully inside its own cell even when lunging, opening wings or lying down.
Character: 蝕天巨煞 (god_chaos_6). A SKY-ECLIPSE FIEND, complete hulking grey-black demon with a blunt horned head, two long muscular arms and two digitigrade legs, bone shoulder spikes, a short dusty plum waistcloth and dull amber chest marks.
Palette: 煞黑／暗琥珀. Full original anatomy suited to this monster; keep all equipment consistent.
Idle: subtle breathing and head/shoulder changes. Move: six clearly articulated alternating leg/knee/ankle steps, arms counter-swing. Attack: ready, withdraw the described weapon or claw arm, wind up, strike strongly LEFT with that weapon/fist/claw, follow through, recover to ready. Death: recoil, knees buckle, fall sideways, land, settle, complete full-body corpse and gear.
Return ONLY the clean transparent 24-frame sprite sheet.

npc_god_chaos_8: Edit this exact existing 24-frame pixel-art game sprite sheet. User says this simple design is slightly TOO simple: increase visual detail by ONLY ABOUT 20%, a modest refinement, not a redesign. KEEP the exact same recognizable navy-blue and warm amber-orange floating elemental, identical silhouette, proportions, two short swept horns, glowing amber eyes and round chest core, short blunt curled floating tail with NO humanoid legs or feet. KEEP only TWO color families: desaturated deep NAVY BLUE shades and restrained AMBER ORANGE shades. Add a modest amount of broad sculpted material definition: one extra beveled plane on each shoulder plate, two simple angular overlapping forearm panels, a subtle stern brow/cheek facet, 2 or 3 short clean seam lines around the chest/core collar, and one additional broad ridge on the short curved tail. About 20% more designed surface structure, no more. Retain broad readable pixel clusters, clean low-resolution dark-fantasy RPG sprite shading, not overly smooth cartoon, not noisy realism. No white horns, no bone, no new accent colors, no electric vein networks, no detailed cracks, smoke strings, filigree, tiny runes, lots of particles or jagged excess spikes. Do not return to the very complex original. Every frame should get the same restrained extra plate/facet detail. PRESERVE sheet dimensions 1536x1024, 6 columns x4 rows, 24 independent full sprites in equal cells, camera faces LEFT, same scale and placement, alpha padding. Preserve existing action order/gestures: six IDLE hover, six HOVER movement (no stepping), six attacks with one clean amber magic slash to left inside cell, six DYING collapse-to-rubble poses ending low. Keep the same short broad curled lower body in all alive frames, never a long cone or needle. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, alpha zero outside sprites. No floor/shadow/gradient/fog/checkerboard/text/grid, no extra characters. Pixel art edges remain crisp.
